_comment: Cache the Yaegi WASM and bootstrap shim aggressively but NOT immutable — the files are unhashed (public/yaegi/yaegi.wasm) so a Yaegi upgrade reuses the same path. max-age=86400 means a return visit within 24h skips the network entirely; after that the browser revalidates with If-Modified-Since. design-docs/20 proposer-cycle round 2. Pair with the <link rel=preload> in BaseLayout for the cold-start path.
